scope: Reviewed inventory delta of decision (a) W2: identifier renames only. Each renamed external keeps its ordered symbol-table position and every field except its name; every relocation naming it follows the rename. Accepted contributions stay byte-, flag- and ordered-relocation identical; an accepted caller names a renamed symbol only where its reviewed binding (evidence/wrapW2_binding_review_2026_10_31.json) renames exactly that symbol. No acceptance of pending functions.
method: Canonical and candidate unit compiled once each with the pinned VC5 toolchain (candidate in a mirror of src/ with every batch candidate); the declaration is the exact symbol-table delta (FILE records compared path-normalized), checked with check_delta of reviewed-unit-delta-v2.
